description: This file defines the ITransactionClient interface in the Orleans namespace, which provides methods for executing transactions asynchronously with different delegate signatures.

classes.name: ITransactionClient
classes.description: An interface for executing transactional operations asynchronously, with methods to run transactions with different delegate signatures.

methods.name: RunTransaction
methods.description: Executes a transaction asynchronously with a delegate that returns a Task, indicating completion without a result.

methods.name: RunTransaction
methods.description: Executes a transaction asynchronously with a delegate that returns a Task<bool>, indicating whether the transaction should commit.
